prompt: Today is a Friday. What day of the week will it be exactly 100 days from today?
explanation: The weekday repeats every 7 days. 100 divided by 7 leaves a remainder of 2, since 98 is exactly 14 weeks. So 100 days later is 2 weekdays after Friday, which is Sunday.
